PacketDefinitions.Description: Opt-in party recruitment protocol for the NewUI client, scoped to one GameServer. Version 1 JSON DTOs are defined under GameLogic/PartyMatching. Original S6 party packets are unchanged.

Packet.Name: PartyMatchingRequestExtended
Packet.SentWhen: The user opens, searches, publishes, cancels, applies to, or reviews party recruitment. Requests are limited to 2048 bytes including the five-byte envelope. Passwords are encrypted by the normal game connection.
Packet.CausedReaction: The server validates permissions and sends a requester's snapshot. It never trusts client-supplied leader identity, membership, map or capacity.

Field.Name: Data
Field.Description: UTF-8 JSON PartyMatchingRequest. No trailing zero. Operation 0 list, 1 publish, 2 stop, 3 apply, 4 withdraw, 5 accept, 6 reject.

Packet.Name: PartyMatchingSnapshotExtended
Packet.SentWhen: A version 1 matching request is processed, including rejections.
Packet.CausedReaction: The client updates its paged list and private pending applications. It only changes party membership from the existing authoritative party packets.

Field.Name: Data
Field.Description: UTF-8 JSON PartyMatchingSnapshot. At most eight ads and twenty private applications. Passwords and password hashes are never sent.
